reproduction_target: Reproduce the computational analysis of the PYL1 abscisic-acid (ABA) receptor deep-mutational-scanning experiment: from GluePCA (Glueable Protein-fragment Complementation Assay) deep-sequencing of >3,500 PYL1 mutant dose-response curves, estimate variant binding/abundance fitness with DiMSum, fit four-parameter Hill dose-response models to extract EC50 / B0 / Binf / Hill parameters, compute structural distances and integrate external stability predictions (FoldX, DDMut, ThermoMPNN, GetContacts, ConSurf), and regenerate the manuscript main + Extended Data figures via the custom R scripts in github.com/lehner-lab/ABA_receptor. Wet-lab library construction, in-vivo selection and DNA sequencing are input-generating steps (W=0), not computationally reproduced.
granularity_note: IMPORTANT: the bioRxiv v1 full-text HTML contains NO Materials & Methods section (section order runs Discussion -> Data availability -> Code availability); computational detail is drawn from figure-legend / results prose plus the code-repo README and repo tree (stage-1 prose only; the R scripts and DiMSum config were NOT read line-by-line). Coarse one-step-per-computational-stage. Named tools: DiMSum (variant fitness), R 4.5.1+ with drc / growthcurver / bio3d / ggplot2 ecosystem, and external predictors FoldX / DDMut / ThermoMPNN / GetContacts / ConSurf whose outputs are shipped as static data. The repo is unusually complete (all intermediate .RData fitness objects, preprocessed data, PDB inputs, prediction outputs, supplementary tables and per-figure R scripts are shipped), so data/code coverage is high; the limiting factor for readiness is purely software-environment capture, which is floating.

steps.label: Variant fitness estimation with DiMSum: from GluePCA deep-sequencing reads (ENA PRJEB89674) count PYL1 variants pre/post selection and compute binding-fitness (PYL1-ABI1, 12- and 21-concentration series) and abundance-fitness (PYL1-PYL1, 0 / 250 uM ABA) estimates. DiMSum output .RData objects are shipped under data/DiMSum/

Preprocessing and four-parameter Hill dose-response curve fitting (scripts/Processing/Pre-process_*_DiMSum.R and *_dose-response_curves_12conc/21conc.R): fit Hill models per variant to extract EC50, B0 (basal), Binf (maximal) and Hill-coefficient parameters using R drc / growthcurver; outputs data/DRCs/*_parameters_Hill_*.RData

Structural / thermodynamic feature integration: side-chain distance calculations to (+)-ABA and ABI1 interfaces (scripts/Processing/Distance_calculations_PYL1-ABA-ABI1.R, R bio3d over PDB 3KAY/3JRS/3KDJ) and integration of external stability/contact predictions (FoldX, DDMut, ThermoMPNN, GetContacts) and ConSurf conservation grades; prediction outputs shipped as static CSV/TXT under data/Predictions/ and data/PYL1_consurf_grades.txt

Figure regeneration: per-figure custom R scripts (scripts/Figure1-6/*.R, scripts/FigureED1-7/*.R) produce the manuscript main and Extended Data PDFs (results/) via the ggplot2 / pheatmap / bio3d / GGally / cowplot / viridis ecosystem, including variant-effect heatmaps, volcano plots, PCA, distance-decay and dose-response spectra

headline.inference_inclusive_upper_bound: RI ceiling on all 4 computational steps. R★ not assignable at stage1. Data and code coverage are strong: the repo ships all DiMSum fitness .RData objects, preprocessed data, Hill-parameter outputs, PDB structure inputs, external prediction outputs, supplementary tables and every per-figure R script, and raw reads are deposited at ENA PRJEB89674. The binding constraint is the software environment: the README pins only 'R version 4.5.1 or later' (a floating floor) and lists ~20 R packages WITHOUT versions; the repo tree carries no renv.lock, DESCRIPTION, environment.yml, requirements.txt, conda-lock or Dockerfile, and external tool versions (DiMSum, FoldX, DDMut, ThermoMPNN, GetContacts, ConSurf) are unspecified. Because the capture claim is 'floating' (not exact_pins_partial / release_snapshot / env_lock_claimed / container_digest_claimed), this paper is NOT a stage2 R★ candidate: even a perfect stage2 run could not exceed RI without a pinned/lockable environment.
headline.coverage: 4 computational steps assessed from figure-legend/results prose + code-repo README/tree (bioRxiv v1 has no Methods section; R scripts and DiMSum config not read line-by-line). No wet-lab steps reproduced (W=0); GluePCA library construction, selection and sequencing are input-generating.

gaps.how_to_close: Mint a tagged release archived to Zenodo (DOI) and cite the specific commit/DOI in the paper.
